--typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --import-alias '@/*' --no-git

Key decisions in the plan:
- Scaffolds **into the repo root** (`.`) so existing `.git`, `docs/`, `DESIGN.md`, `.env.example` survive untouched
- `--no-git` prevents `create-next-app` from clobbering the existing git repo
- `--src-dir` produces `src/app/` which downstream tasks 08–11 depend on
- Package manager: **npm** (matches existing `.gitignore`)
